name: Tilbroquinol

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and Saudi Arabia, first in 1999 — for liver harm

summary: Tilbroquinol was taken off the market in France and Saudi Arabia starting in 1999 due to liver damage [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a medium risk score of 58 for liver problems [M]. That same computer model, also not based on human testing, calculated a low risk score of 20 for heart issues [M].
